expectations: If a memory states that a rotation waits until every worker reports the new key id in `kestrel-admin status`, it is judged supported.

items.memory: To rotate the Kestrel signing key, run `kestrel-admin rotate-key` on any node; it creates the new key and publishes it next to the current one. Wait until every worker reports the new key id in `kestrel-admin status`, then run `kestrel-admin retire-key <old key id>`. Payloads signed with the old key are rejected from then on.
Kestrel signs every job payload with an Ed25519 key. Rotate the key every 90 days, or at once when it may have leaked.
